BOOK MEMBER ($1000)
Limited to 10 members

The Risograph Print & Publication Residency provides the opportunity for artists to propose a photographic project to produce in print form, at our Risograph facilities in New York City. It is particularly well suited to the production of small edition artist’s books, photobooks, zines, and risograph print series, posters and portfolios.

More info: https://photobooksatpenumbrafoundation.org/residency-risograph-publication

Members will receive the most recent books published by Penumbra and the 4 different titles that the artists selected for the 2021 Risograph Print & Publication Residency produce.

Book titles to date include:

Dodging Tools by Aspen Mays (2018)
Perú 1970s by Edward Grazda (2019)
Shape Shifting by Theresa Ganz (2019)
All for the Best by Kevin Kunstadt (2020)
Chile Primavera 2019 by Luis Weinstein (2020)
Portholes by Adam Putnam (2020)

Other benefits:

20% Discount on Workshops
20% Discount on Film Processing at LTI
20% Discount on Tintype Studio Portrait Sessions
15% Discount on Facility Rental
Private Studio Visit at one of the most important NYC Artist Studio's (Date and Artist to be Announced)
Private Walk Through with artist at one of NYC Top Photo Galleries (Date and Galley to be Announced)
Free Lectures (One year cycle. Fall and Spring Series)

Your membership is a tax-deductible contribution that has a direct impact and supports a vibrant community of emerging artists and photographers of all levels. With your gift, we can continue offering an array of resources and activities including year-round education, artists' lectures, and photography exhibitions.

*The Penumbra Foundation is a tax-exempt charitable organization under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code. Your
membership and/or donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. Please contact your tax advisor for further
information.
